name: Run Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  LATEST_GO_VERSION: "1.26"

jobs:
  test:
    name: ubuntu-latest @ Go 1.26
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up Go 1.26
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: 1.26

      - name: Run Tests
        run: go test -race --coverprofile=coverage.coverprofile --covermode=atomic ./...

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        if: success() && 1.26 == env.LATEST_GO_VERSION && ubuntu-latest == 'ubuntu-latest'
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token:
          fail_ci_if_error: false
